note: Host mode's working-directory checks (ADR 0004, the shared-process failure model, item 5; ADR 0009, the Bun host SDK). The host passes a directory, which must be a directory it can write and its own working directory. The host SDK checks it before it starts the engine (connect, a HostError with the code), and the engine checks it again in the handshake against the workdir of the host's hello (a welcome reject with the code). Each case runs in a fresh temporary directory holding cwd/ (the host's working directory, where the check runs), other/ (a second directory), link (a symbolic link to cwd/) and file (a regular file); missing does not exist. workdir is the path the host passes, relative to that directory, or "." as written. cwd_mode and other_mode, when set, are the octal modes of cwd/ and other/; a case with one is skipped as root, which writes through any mode. expect is the refusal's code, or null when the directory is usable.

cases.title: the working directory, by its absolute path, is usable
the working directory, as a relative path, is usable
a symbolic link to the working directory is usable: both are compared without links
the working directory, read-only, is workdir_not_writable
another directory that is read-only is workdir_not_writable: writability is checked first
a directory that does not exist is workdir_not_writable
